as_told.title: Scientology's belief in a Pleiadian-versus-reptilian conflict

plain: The Church of Scientology, a religion founded in the United States, believes a great war is going on between humanlike people from the Pleiades, a cluster of stars, and reptilian beings from Zeta Reticuli, a nearby star system. The lawyer Dan Sheehan tells Michels this on two episodes, once in 2024 and again in 2025, using nearly the same words each time. He presents it as what the church believes and names no source for it.
